en-US.name: Fluent Scrobbler
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fluent Scrobbler — 1.3.1 Release Notes (2026-11-11)
Fluent Scrobbler 1.3.1 addresses startup network race conditions and offline mode deadlocks, improving background sync reliability and cache recovery.
Bug Fixes
- Offline cache recovery: Fixed lock drops and race conditions inside OfflineCacheWorker during network transitions, ensuring the app automatically recovers from offline mode upon any successful Last.fm API call.
- Boot credential handling: Prevented empty credentials from being cached during early Windows startup.
- Request resilience: Added transient retry logic to both scrobble submissions and "Now Playing" status requests.
- Network connection stability: Optimized SocketsHttpHandler with keep-alive pings and automatic IPv4 fallback to prevent dropped connections.
- UI cache synchronization: Configured views to immediately refresh recent tracks once offline cache synchronization completes.
Bug Reports & Support
Despite our best efforts to ensure a polished release, bugs may occasionally occur. If you encounter any issues, please open a bug report here.
